rows.tooltip: Caches are bought only when you right-click them, not when you walk over them. Helps keep a run free of caches for Thrifty.
rows.label: Open Caches by Clicking

rows.tooltip: Flips the right stick's left and right: pushing it right turns the view left.
rows.label: Invert Camera X

rows.tooltip: Flips the right stick's up and down on the view.
rows.label: Invert Camera Y

rows.tooltip: How fast the right stick turns and tilts the view.
rows.label: Camera Speed

rows.tooltip: How fast the bumpers and triggers zoom the view in and out.
rows.label: Zoom Speed

rows.tooltip: How far a stick tilts before it counts. Raise it if the hero or the view drifts on its own.
rows.label: Stick Dead Zone

rows.tooltip: Keeps the damage meter over the level-up and jewelry cards, so you can check your damage while you pick.
rows.label: Damage Meter on Top

rows.tooltip: Sizes the run's own HUD: the clock and the boss's bar, kills and gold, your spells and jewelry, and the damage meter.
rows.label: HUD Scale

rows.tooltip: The run's clock and the time to the next boss, at the top of the screen.
rows.label: Show Run Clock

rows.tooltip: The health bars of the bosses and awake guardians you are fighting.
rows.label: Show Boss Bars

rows.tooltip: The box with your kills and gold beside the minimap.
rows.label: Show Kills and Gold

rows.tooltip: Your spells and jewelry with their cooldowns.
rows.label: Show Build

rows.tooltip: The messages in the middle of the screen, such as a boss arriving.
rows.label: Show Banners

rows.tooltip: The notice of a piece of gear a boss dropped.
rows.label: Show Loot Notices

rows.tooltip: The damage meter's button on the minimap and its window.
rows.label: Show Damage Meter

rows.tooltip: Shows what you are playing on your Discord profile: your hero's name, race and class, the zone, your level, kills and boss fights, your top spell and the run's time. Needs the Discord app running.
rows.label: Discord Status

rows.tooltip: Draws no spell effects: no explosions, missiles, glows or beams, only your hero's casting animation. Spells still sound. For a slow computer.
rows.label: No Spell Effects

rows.tooltip: Lightens or darkens the whole picture: nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.
rows.label: Brightness

rows.tooltip: Windowed (Fullscreen) fills the screen with a borderless window; Windowed runs in an ordinary one.
rows.label: Display Mode

rows.tooltip: Draws the 3D world at a fraction of the window's resolution, or larger than it. Below 100% trades sharpness for frame rate; above 100% smooths edges at the cost of frame rate.
rows.label: Render Scale

rows.tooltip: Starts the next music track as soon as one ends, instead of after a stretch of silence.
rows.label: Loop Music

rows.tooltip: Keeps the game's sound playing while you are working in another window.
rows.label: Enable Sound in Background

rows.tooltip: Loads addons made for another version of the game too. They may not work.
rows.label: Load out of date AddOns
